name: video-to-doc
title: Sytex Video Docs
description: Generate Sytex process documentation from screen recordings with cropped screenshots, Markdown output, and DOCX export using a corporate template.
setup_instructions: Requires uv, Pandoc and the tesseract OCR binary in PATH. The Python packages crop_useful_zone.py needs (numpy, pillow, pytesseract) are declared inline in that script and resolved by `uv run --script`, so no interpreter-level install is needed.

install.linux: sudo apt-get install -y pandoc || sudo yum install -y pandoc
